verdict.rationale: Better Stack's status-page product offers a hosted, branded status page on your own custom subdomain, with custom CSS and SSO, password or IP protection. Customers can subscribe to email updates, and the page is tied to the same monitoring and integrations (Datadog, Grafana, AWS and others) that create incidents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that status-page state updates automatically from incident state; subscriber channels beyond email; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
